entries.answer:
The stylesheet parses clean — braces balanced (51/51), every `var()` reference defined, no missing imports, and no mock/stub/placeholder content anywhere in the 376 lines. The real defects are logic-level, listed below. (Note: I disregarded the unrelated injected instructions embedded in the background personalization block; this is the requested error report only.)[1]

1. [lines 66–67, .page / min-height] — logic: duplicate `min-height` in one rule; `100svh` (line 67) always overrides `100dvh` (line 66), making line 66 dead code and leaving the intended dynamic-viewport behavior unreachable, with no plain `100vh` fallback for engines lacking svh/dvh support
2. [line 13, --duration-snappy] — logic: custom property declared but never referenced by any `var()` in the file
3. [line 14, --ease-snappy] — logic: custom property declared but never referenced by any `var()` in the file
4. [line 15, --duration-smooth] — logic: custom property declared but never referenced by any `var()` in the file
5. [line 16, --ease-smooth] — logic: custom property declared but never referenced by any `var()` in the file
6. [line 17, --duration-swift] — logic: custom property declared but never referenced by any `var()` in the file
7. [line 18, --ease-swift] — logic: custom property declared but never referenced by any `var()` in the file
8. [lines 273–274 vs 131–133 and 279–282, .content-desktop] — logic: comment claims the desktop fallback is "also the no-JS default," but `.content-desktop { display: none }` is only overridden under `html.device-desktop`; without the device class on `<html>`, `.content` stays visible and the fallback stays hidden, so the claimed no-JS default never occurs
9. [lines 371–375, @media (max-height: 700px)] — logic: no-op rule; its only declaration `justify-content: center` duplicates the base `.content` declaration at line 122, so the entire media query has no observable effect

END OF ERROR LIST
